meaning: Primary API/source semantics, not native account qualification, fee schedule, sign certificate or live acceptance.

references.finding: Python ticket filter selects an ORDER ticket; select the exact returned deal. Returned fields include order,position_id,volume,commission,fee and native time. Error returnsNone, distinct from an empty result.
Native deal properties identify entry type,order,stable position,symbol,volume,commission and separate deal fee. Missing properties cannot be inferred as0.
Official history aggregation example adds commission and swap to profit; this supplies the recorded signed-cash-component convention, not an account-specific native qualification.
Immediate deal commission is distinct from deferred day/month charges and blocked funds. Observed zero or an immediate cost does not complete future charges or settlement.
